title: Maintaining Functional Mouse Hematopoietic Stem Cells in Vitro Without Division
author: Belmonte, Kent
materials: EasySep Mouse Hematopoietic Progenitor Enrichment kit

steps.title: Harvest bone marrow cells
steps.instruction: Crush femora, tibiae and pelvic bones (and optionally spine and forearms) from each mouse in 10 mL PBS containing 2 % FCS using a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Initial centrifugation and resuspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the bone‑marrow suspension to a 50 mL conical polypropylene tube, centrifuge 5 min at 300 × g at room temperature, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 3 mL PBS/2 % FCS.

steps.title: Red blood cell lysis
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl, STEMCELL) to the cell suspension, incubate on ice for 10 min vortexing after the first 5 min, then fill the tube to 50 mL with PBS/2 % FCS and centrifuge 5 min at 300 × g at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend cells for downstream work
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL per mouse PBS/2 % FCS and transfer to a polystyrene round‑bottom tube. Add 1 mL PBS/2 % FCS to the empty 50 mL tube from the previous step and keep this leftover suspension for non‑depleted control samples.

steps.title: Prepare FACS control tubes
steps.instruction: Filter the control suspension through a 50‑µm filter and aliquot 100 µL into each of the following FACS control tubes: unstained, 7‑AAD only, FITC only, PE only, APC only, PE‑Cy7 only, BV421 only.

steps.title: Optional lineage depletion (EasySep)
steps.instruction: For each mouse, add 10 µL EasySep Mouse Hematopoietic Progenitor Cell Isolation cocktail, incubate 15 min on ice; add 15 µL EasySep Streptavidin RapidSpheres, incubate another 15 min on ice; bring volume to 2.5 mL with PBS/2 % FCS; place tube in EasySep Magnet for 3 min at room temperature, transfer supernatant to a new tube and repeat the magnet step once more; centrifuge 5 min at 300 × g at room temperature; finally resuspend cells in 100 µL per mouse PBS/2 % FCS for antibody staining.

steps.title: Add antibodies to control and sample tubes
steps.instruction: Add the following antibodies at the indicated dilutions: CD45‑FITC 1:100, CD48‑APC 1:100, CD150‑PE‑Cy7 1:100, EPCR‑PE 1:100, Sca‑1‑BV421 1:200. Prepare a master mix for sample tubes if more than one sample is stained.

steps.title: Incubate antibody staining
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube, incubate on ice in the dark for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash and add viability dye
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL PBS/2 % FCS to each tube, centrifuge 5 min at 300 × g at room temperature, discard supernatant. Resuspend control tubes in 300 µL PBS/2 % FCS and add 1:1000 7‑AAD to the 7‑AAD‑only control tube. Resuspend each sample tube in 500 µL per mouse 1:1000 7‑AAD in PBS/2 % FCS, filter through a 50‑µm filter into a new polypropylene tube, then add another 500 µL 1:1000 7‑AAD in PBS/2 % FCS to the original tube and filter the rinse through the same filter.

steps.title: Prepare final cell suspension for sorting
steps.instruction: Adjust the final volume to approximately 1 mL per mouse, filter once more through a 50‑µm filter, and resuspend cells in PBS containing 2 % FCS (translucent appearance).

steps.title: Sort single HSCs into 96‑well plates
steps.instruction: Using a cell sorter, deposit single viable HSCs into individual wells of a U‑bottom 96‑well plate containing the appropriate hibernation medium (no SCF or TPO).

steps.title: Settle cells and visualize culture
steps.instruction: After sorting, adjust the microscope field of view to encompass the whole well and focus on the centre. To bring cells to the centre, centrifuge the plate 5 min at 240 × g. Note that 20–40 % of single cells survive 7 days in hibernation medium (≈98 % survive in 300 ng/mL SCF‑supplemented medium) and ≈99 % of input HSCs do not divide during the 7‑day culture.
